meta.title: Ache life-to-comic skill｜首发5种画风预设
meta.anchor: 同一三格故事：有一阵风，替我按了暂停
meta.summary: 只比较画风，不比较题材。每张都必须保留白底、手帐逻辑与漫画推进。
meta.candidate_activation: 首次使用先以用户当次小内容生成封面与标准页，用户确认后只对当前书激活
meta.selection_note: 首发仅包含01至05；02为已验证默认，其余四个为可选候选。
meta.selector_rule: 五张封面使用同一母题、各自媒介特征与统一白底；编号和名称由确定性排版添加

preserve: 同一封面母题：蓝色车票被风从城市窗边吹起
每个方向用自己的媒介和构图语言完成封面
不设置主角，避免人物画法干扰画风选择
3:4竖版、纯白主背景、图片内无文字
avoid: 儿童画、萌系大眼、幼儿比例
照搬参考图题材、人物或具体构图

next_prompt_hints: 为前五个方向分别标注最适合的内容场景
指出前五个方向需要互相借用的局部媒介属性
只让01至05进入人物、无人物、照片和知识页压力测试

routes.label: 01 云层水粉
routes.rationale: 深蓝天空、灰青厚云和可见笔触最接近用户最初提供的云层与城市参考，画面具有收藏感。
routes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a 3:4 vertical comic-journal style preset proof. Create one finished page with three clearly separated hand-drawn panels on a dominant clean white background. Keep the exact shared story: panel 1 a fictional adult East Asian woman with short black hair, black cardigan, white shirt and a red hair tie on her right wrist pauses at a white desk as a white curtain lifts in the wind; panel 2 has no person, only a city canyon, immense sculptural clouds, a pale blue wind ribbon and one blue bus ticket lifted by wind; panel 3 she tapes one intact small sky photograph and the blue ticket into a white notebook at home. The same pale blue wind ribbon crosses all three panels. Style: opaque gouache, visible dry-brush edges, deep cobalt sky fragments, layered gray-green and white cloud volume, simplified mature figure shapes, restrained black, cobalt, gray-green and vermilion accents. Preserve white page breathing room. Mature editorial illustration, tactile and collectible, not cute. No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, signatures or watermark. Avoid beige page, childish proportions, big eyes, generic digital painting, glossy 3D, three repeated camera angles.

routes.label: 02 雪色粉蜡
routes.rationale: 来自用户雪地小屋参考的柔和粉蜡、轻色块与安静留白，适合柔软回忆，但必须避免幼儿绘本化。
routes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a 3:4 vertical comic-journal style preset proof. Create one finished three-panel page on a crisp white background using the exact shared woman, story, blue wind ribbon, blue ticket and notebook snapshot. Style: mature oil-pastel and wax-crayon blocks with soft powdery grain, few contour lines, pale icy blue, cloud white, quiet coral red and muted butter yellow used only as small accents. Simplify architecture and clouds into elegant broad shapes while keeping adult anatomy and clear actions. The page should feel airy, calm and contemporary, not like a preschool book. Preserve three distinct camera beats and generous white page margins. No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, signatures or watermark. Avoid beige paper, cute round faces, childish houses, rainbow palette, fuzzy low-detail characters, decorative stickers and repeated panel compositions.
next_prompt_hints: test stronger emotion without adding saturation

routes.label: 03 白纸彩铅
routes.family: 用户参考机制｜成熟彩铅
routes.rationale: 保留韩系生活杂志参考中的彩铅纸感和日常观察，去掉儿童比例、彩虹字与拥挤信息。
routes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a 3:4 vertical comic-journal style preset proof. Render the exact shared three-panel story with the same adult woman and objects. Style: refined colored-pencil drawing on bright white paper, visible pencil hatching and grain, thin graphite contours, nuanced adult facial proportions, small areas of navy, forest green, brick red and faded sky blue. Everyday Korean sketch-diary warmth translated into a mature editorial register: observational, intimate, lightly imperfect, never juvenile. Let small pencil marks and one or two purposeful handwritten-looking strokes exist as abstract marks only, never readable text. Keep three clear cinematic beats and the intact photo/ticket in panel 3. No actual text, letters, numbers, signatures or watermark. Avoid crowded magazine cover composition, cute children, big heads, rainbow lettering, sticker spam and beige background.
next_prompt_hints: choose more graphite or more color

routes.label: 04 双色线记
routes.rationale: 朱红与黑线、荒诞尺度和留白具有强记忆点，适合想法与情绪页；需要守住成熟度。
routes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a 3:4 vertical comic-journal style preset proof. Use the exact shared three-panel story and character anchors. Style: loose intelligent line drawing in vermilion red and charcoal black with occasional pale mint wash, large white negative space, deliberate uneven lines, editorial absurdity and subtle scale distortion. In panel 2 let the cloud feel improbably large and the blue ticket tiny but important; in panel 3 the wind ribbon may curl into the notebook as a visual metaphor. Keep adult proportions and restrained expressions. The panels may have irregular hand-drawn borders but the reading order must remain clear. No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, signatures or watermark. Avoid childlike doodles, clownish faces, dense decoration, beige paper, generic vector icons and copying any reference character or vehicle.

routes.label: 05 细墨轻彩
routes.rationale: 透明水彩与城市速写在日记、旅行和生活记录中适配面最广，照片与实景转译成本较低。
routes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a 3:4 vertical comic-journal style preset proof. Create the exact shared three-panel story. Style: fine black fountain-pen linework with transparent watercolor washes, natural water blooms, slightly uneven urban-sketch contours, clear adult anatomy, soft daylight and restrained ultramarine, cool gray, sap green and a small vermilion accent. Preserve bright untouched white paper around and inside each panel. The second panel should work as an observational city sketch without a person; the third should integrate an intact small sky photograph and ticket like real journal material, not decorative stickers. No readable text, letters, numbers, signatures or watermark. Avoid muddy beige wash, travel-poster prettiness, cute cartoon faces, excessive splashes, technical architecture drawing and three identical views.
